title: Jo Jones sends for Lovett; the Carnegie Hall introduction he missed
summary: Jo Jones invited Lovett to the Newport festival at Carnegie Hall, where Buck Clayton called his name but he did not hear in time.

blocks.x: Crook, do you want to have something to say?
The reason that Lovett was in New
York, his friend, Jo Jones, had sent for him.
Last year?
Last year, to come to New York.
To do what?
He was introduced at Carnegie Hall.
Baby was?
Baby was.

Well they always played together, right?
Oh yeah. He was in New York.
Well what was the occasion in Carnegie Hall, Baby?
Well, it was the Newport News Jazz Festival.
Newport Jazz Festival.
Yeah.
And they were introducing the famous jazz musicians?
That's right, yeah, and --

Buck Clayton, yeah, he was emceeing the deal at Carnegie Hall there and he called my name twice, man. I mean the first time he called it I didn't hear. Joe and I were down there [running] and he called it again and I still didn't get up there so I didn't have a chance to get introduced. Boy I sure hated that too, boy, but anyway, he told them about me anyway.
That's great, Baby. Now that's the first I've heard of this.
Oh yeah, but I wanted the people to see me on the stage, you understand.

Couldn't. You know things go like that.
Oh, you were too far away?

Well at least your name was in Carnegie Hall at the Newport Jazz Festival.
Oh sure, yeah. I sure did hate it I didn't go.
